scripts.build: npm run test:framework && next build && node scripts/prepare-standalone.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:course && next typegen && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:framework: npm run prepare:course && tsx --test tests/framework-*.test.ts tests/framework-*.test.tsx
scripts.dev:framework: npm run prepare:course && node scripts/framework.mjs dev
scripts.build:framework: npm run test:framework && node scripts/framework.mjs build
